title: Preceptor - Telemedicine
job_description:
Company Overview

MomentMD is the first of its kind digital health solution designed specifically for colleges and universities. Our innovative platform trains future healthcare professionals with essential skills for delivering top-tier digital health care during their clinical rotations. Moreover, MomentMD equips patients with the tools they need to take charge of their health. At MomentMD, our mission is to revolutionize the way health care is delivered. Through our cutting-edge digital health platform we are dedicated to empowering both healthcare professionals and patients by harnessing the power of digital health, optimizing diagnosis' and providing high-quality care.

Summary

MomentMD is seeking a dedicated Internal Medicine Preceptor to join our team. In this role, you will play a crucial role in providing students with a transformative clinical experience, equipping them with the practical skills necessary for their professional development.

Responsibilities

Facilitate student participation in patient encounters through 3-way HIPAA-compliant consultations (this should be done with your current telehealth patient panel)
Set clear goals and objectives for the practicum experience, aligning them with student outcome objectives.
Guide students in applying theoretical knowledge to real-world practice.
Employ effective teaching methods to support students in achieving their learning objectives.
Evaluate the attainment of student learning objectives.
Provide constructive feedback to students.
Collaborate with faculty in evaluating student performance

Requirements

MD, DO, PA, or PMHNP
Valid medical license to practice in the state of employment.
Strong communication skills and the ability to work effectively in a remote setting.
Telemedicine patient panel
Familiarity with telemedicine practices, platforms, and regulations is highly desirable.
Precepting experience is preferred

Pay range and compensation package - $4500-$7000/month

If you are passionate about redefining healthcare delivery and making a difference in the lives of students, we invite you to apply for the Primary Care Preceptor position at MomentMD today!

Job Type: Contract

Pay: $4,500.00 - $7,000.00 per month

Benefits:

Flexible schedule
Referral program

Application Question(s):

What is your CURRENT telemedicine volume on a weekly basis? (Video calls only)
Are MD/DO/PA/NP students able to join your encounters? Please get admin approval first, if required, before answering this question.
Have you ever been named in a malpractice lawsuit?
What's your current telemedicine schedule?

Experience:

telemedicine: 1 year (Preferred)

License/Certification:

Board Certified in Psychiatry (Required)

Work Location: Remote
